opportunities.title: 1:1 Competitor Color Harmony, Typography & 24px Spacing Rhythm
opportunities.competitor_evidence: 1:1 visual side-by-side against INCIDecoder, Skinsort, Paula's Choice Beautypedia (OpenRouter / Zola / Colorwise restraint): Warm silk apothecary color harmony, full-bottle uncropped skincare photography across all menu and ingredient pages, plain skincare language (never 'stratum corneum'), and zero 99c pill clutter.
opportunities.hypothesis_plain_english: Eliminate both 'alien' neon colors/font-size soup AND dull/drab stripped grey layouts. Enforce a cohesive editorial/developer color palette, uniform 24px section spacing, Title Case hero H1s, and at most 2 clean CTAs per view.
opportunities.validation_check: Playwright live prod screenshot audit across desktop (1440px) and mobile (390px) confirms consistent spacing and zero CTA bombardment.

opportunities.title: Site-Wide Unique Photography Across All Top-Menu & Sub-Venue Pages
opportunities.competitor_evidence: INCIDecoder, Skinsort, Paula's Choice Beautypedia rich product/venue photography across every top-menu route and subpage
opportunities.hypothesis_plain_english: Deploy high-taste, unique imagery across ALL top-menu pages and individual venue/template subpages (never only the homepage, never repeating the same image twice on one page, never cutting off bottles/subjects with wrong aspect-ratio cropping, and never placing text overlays on top of photography).
opportunities.validation_check: Zero duplicate URLs on any single page, zero text-over-image overlays, natural aspect ratios preserved across all menu routes.
